big_picture: Execute Programme #393 as a chronological, auditable optimization campaign for reproducible one-month net trading return. The current pre-freeze problem is to replace history-wide fixed parameter selection with a causal adaptive procedure that can choose experts, horizons, sizing, position actions and execution behavior from point-in-time state.
why_zoomed_in: Issues #459/#429/#430/#431 established that V2 contains material but conditional and time-sensitive development value: joint side-specific policy gains, state-dependent sizing, fast adaptation value, and strong execution-latency sensitivity. #465 therefore becomes the final broad discovery stage before #414 champion simplification and freeze.
tested_role_target_horizon: Completed development work through #431 tested joint signal/side/regime policies, lifecycle/position structure, sizing/risk, and execution/adaptation over chronological pre-2023 outers. #465 will test a point-in-time time-instance representation and causal adaptive whole-system controller without accessing protected confirmation.

historical_facts.observed: #459 promoted a joint development policy at +0.324275 percentage points/month mean outer improvement; #429 found no promoted static lifecycle variant but confirmed material contribution from strength gating, loss cooldown and the long specialist veto; #430 promoted state-dependent sizing at +0.1276375 percentage points/month; #431 selected decay20 at +0.4456875 percentage points/month versus fixed adaptation but the advantage failed under every tested one-session execution delay.
historical_facts.rules_out: The completed evidence rules out the exact failed static lifecycle variants, the tested incremental Stage-2 risk controls, and claims that the selected #431 adaptation is robust to a full-session execution delay. It does not permit protected-confirmation or paper claims.
historical_facts.does_not_rule_out: Previously underpowered, role-unidentifiable, null or exact-role-negative inputs may still have value in scientifically distinct regime, confidence, veto, horizon-selection, sizing, position-management or expert-weighting roles. Dynamic policy selection through time remains untested and is owned by #465.

useful_secondary_observations: The #459 repository-wide advantage map distinguishes empirical negatives from underpowered, role-unidentifiable, source/data-held, untested and positive clues; non-promotion is not automatically evidence of no information.
#429 contribution ablations show the promoted parent materially depends on strength gating and loss cooldown, with a smaller positive long-specialist-veto contribution.
#430 shows that changing exposure can create value conditionally, while uniform fixed scaling is exposure amplification rather than a new source of directional information.
#431 shows a sharp timing boundary: same-session cost/roll/missed-fill stresses preserve the adaptation increment, while a one-session delay removes it.
remaining_untested_roles: Deterministic PIT time-instance state representation across the complete admissible V2 information set
Timestamped TimesFM, Kronos and specialist expert-output archive across admissible horizons
Multiple trailing memory lengths and state-conditional expert effectiveness
Causal expert/feature weighting and model/horizon selection through time
Dynamic existing-position actions: initiate, add, hold, reduce, exit, reverse and abstain
Slow model/parameter adaptation versus fast trade/size adaptation
Development-only hindsight oracle and measurable oracle-to-causal selection gap
Final simplification and freeze of the adaptive procedure under #414
revisit_trigger: Return to upstream research design if #465 cannot reconstruct a candidate field at its true availability timestamp, if an alternative role is not scientifically distinct from a prior negative, or if adaptive selection requires protected outcomes or future-derived diagnostics.
programme_interpretation: V2 development has moved from isolated family optimization to whole-system causal adaptation. The next scientific object is not one fixed fifteen-year parameter vector but a frozen procedure that selects bounded parameters and actions from information available at each timestamp; #414 remains the simplification/freeze gate after #465.
selection_basis: Primary objective remains chronological net percentage return after realistic costs. #465 may search aggressively, but every model, parameter, weight, memory, threshold and action must be selected from prior/inner evidence only and must satisfy minimum executability, sample, concentration, drawdown and stability constraints before #414 can freeze it.

issue_465: Use only development or rolling_research_oos evidence through 2022-12-31.
Keep protected 2023+ confirmation, prospective paper, Saxo SIM and LIVE outcomes unread.
Preserve historical negatives for the exact roles tested; reopen only scientifically distinct roles.
Never present the hindsight oracle as tradable performance.
Stop broad discovery only when a bounded causal adaptive candidate/control set is ready for #414, or when the declared adaptive search cannot causally capture material oracle opportunity.
